about.name: True Convo
about.summary: True Convo is a personal AI app for the Mac. Conversations and memory live on the person's own computer, and nothing goes to an outside AI service unless they approve it.
about.availability: In development. Not available to the public yet.

features.name: The Desk
features.description: A conversation home for talking things through with an AI, with sessions listed on one side and what each session is for on the other.

features.name: Chosen memories
features.description: The person decides exactly what True Convo remembers, folder by folder.

features.name: Dictation anywhere
features.description: Dictation that works anywhere you can type on the Mac. It runs on the Mac unless the person chooses a cloud dictation service.

features.name: Local AI models
features.description: Conversations with an AI model that runs on the Mac itself, so messages never leave the computer.

features.name: Cloud AI models, only with approval
features.description: An optional cloud AI model, used only after the person approves that provider and confirms any paid use.

features.name: This public API
features.description: A read-only service that answers questions about True Convo from public text. It holds no personal data.

faq.question: What is True Convo?
faq.answer: A personal AI app for the Mac, made by Cloudwork Systems. It keeps conversations and memory on the person's own computer.

faq.question: Can I use True Convo today?
faq.answer: Not yet. It is in development and not available to the public.

faq.question: Where does my data go?
faq.answer: It stays on your Mac. Cloudwork Systems does not run servers that collect conversations, memory or recordings, and cannot read them.

faq.question: Does True Convo send my messages to a cloud AI service?
faq.answer: Only if you choose a cloud AI model or cloud dictation service and approve it first. Then True Convo sends that service only what it needs for what you asked.

faq.question: Do I need an account?
faq.answer: No. True Convo does not need an account with Cloudwork Systems, or a ChatGPT or other outside account.

faq.question: Does True Convo show ads or sell data?
faq.answer: No. There are no ads, and Cloudwork Systems does not sell or rent anyone's information.

faq.question: What does this API know about me?
faq.answer: Nothing. It only answers from public text about True Convo, it has no accounts and stores nothing, and it writes no logs of its own.

faq.question: How do I contact the makers?

status.summary: The Mac app is being built and tested by its owner with invented data. Encrypted storage on the Mac and conversations with a local AI model are built and in owner testing.

updates.title: Public API planned
